actual_tool_parameters.prompt:

Preserve its successful ruler-straight horizontal shaft, proportions, face, hands, all clothes and equipment. Reference1 is the pose/geometry authority, NOT the authority for its mistaken sleeve symbol.
The only design correction is the small WHITE official OG mark on the character's LEFT upper-arm orange pocket (viewer RIGHT). Reference2 shows its correct existing pocket position, small size and white print. Reference3 is the official connected OG SHAPE, shown dark only for legibility: render this shape in white on the orange pocket. Preserve the recognizable G with its opening and inward HORIZONTAL BAR. It is NOT the number3, not two stacked right-facing curves, not an infinity symbol. Follow the official connected contours, with generous orange margin, centered on the pocket body; do not enlarge or reshape the pocket, add patches or new lettering. Match the sleeve's perspective naturally.
Retain reference1's continuous horizontal staff across the waist: both long edges are straight parallel lines, a SINGLE continuous axis through both short hand occlusions. All dark necks, silver blunt caps and two red end collars remain coaxial. Exactly ONE flat red center mark. Keep full staff and full head-to-boots figure visible with margins; near-equal staff length to standing height. The hands conform to the same level rod; no offset segment leaving either hand. Right full BLACK glove with RED wrist device, left FINGERLESS glove with one ORANGE screen, no duplicate screen.
Keep the centered raised goggles, silver-white cool-gray hair/blue eyes, current orange jacket/red lapels and clothing lengths, oval white-top opening, internal harness, silver waist hooks, black belt/red shorts, thigh gear, asymmetric socks and boots. Crisp Japanese anime hand-drawn dark linework, flat cel colors and restrained hard-edged shading, no texture haze or white speckles. One complete new illustration, no added labels, panels or actions.
